pose: Top-down or three-quarter view to highlight the broad, triangular shape. Ensure the four backward-pointing horns (two jugal horns at the cheeks, two squamosal horns at the top corners) are distinct and symmetrical. The anterior beak must be sharp and toothless.
educational_focus: Integrated cranial armor and the specific 'four-horn' arrangement that distinguishes it from other thyreophorans.
